meta.units: displacement in face units (1 = distance between outer eye corners, landmarks 33 and 263) per 1 SD of the trait
meta.axes: x along the eye-corner line towards landmark 263; y perpendicular, pointing down
meta.amplitude: amplitude a = a SD of the trait (Oosterhof & Todorov 2008 face models); sign: + = more
meta.apply: dst_px[i] = L_px[i] + a * (dx * ex + dy * ey) * unit, with ex, ey, unit from the face's own eye corners (see aurc/face.py)

DOM_o.description: dominance, orthogonalised to trustworthiness (490 set) - recommended

TRUST.description: trustworthiness, raw model (525 set); correlates with DOM

DOM.description: dominance, raw model (525 set); correlates with TRUST

THREAT.description: threat (525 set); close to DOM minus TRUST

meta.source: Oosterhof & Todorov (2008) PNAS 105:11087; 525- and 490-face databases, Perception and Judgment Lab (tlab.uchicago.edu), FaceGen Modeller 3.2; non-profit academic use
